stem.text: Which statement about p orbitals is correct?

stem.caption: Shape drawn in option A
stem.alt: A small outline drawing of two rounded lobes joined at a point in the middle, side by side: the dumbbell (figure-of-eight) shape of a p orbital.

options.text: All p orbitals are [the two-lobed shape drawn above] shaped.
All p orbitals have a lower energy than an s orbital of the same principal quantum number.
Each of the first four quantum shells contain p orbitals.
Each p orbital can contain a maximum of six electrons.

explanation.text: A p orbital has two lobes on opposite sides of the nucleus, which gives the dumbbell shape drawn in option A. All three p orbitals of a sub-shell (p<sub>x</sub>, p<sub>y</sub>, p<sub>z</sub>) have this shape; they differ only in the axis they point along.

The other statements fail on basic orbital facts: in the same shell an s orbital is lower in energy than the p orbitals, the first shell has only a 1s orbital, and every orbital (of any type) holds at most two electrons. Six is the capacity of a whole p sub-shell of three orbitals.

optionAnalysis.text: Correct. Every p orbital is dumbbell shaped: two lobes either side of the nucleus.
Reversed. Within a shell the s sub-shell is filled first because it is lower in energy than the p sub-shell (e.g. 2s below 2p, 3s below 3p).
The first shell (n = 1) contains only the 1s orbital; p orbitals first appear in the second shell.
Any single orbital holds a maximum of two electrons of opposite spin. Six is the maximum for a p sub-shell (three orbitals), not for one p orbital.

reasoningChain: Recall the shapes: s orbitals are spherical, p orbitals are dumbbell shaped.
Check B against the order of sub-shell energies: s is below p in the same shell, so B is false.
Check C: shell 1 contains only 1s, so C is false.
Check D: one orbital holds at most two electrons, so D is false.

inferredMistakes.text: Confusing the capacity of one p orbital (2 electrons) with the capacity of the p sub-shell (6 electrons) and choosing D.
Forgetting that the first shell has no p sub-shell and choosing C.

issues.note: QP 选项 A 的句子中间嵌了一个小图（p 轨道哑铃形）：'All p orbitals are [图] shaped.'。mcqOptions 选项文字不能嵌图片，这里把小图截成 figures/q1_fig_option_a.png 放在选项前面（caption 是自拟的简短描述，QP 没有印 caption），选项 A 文字用 '[the two-lobed shape drawn above]' 代替图形。请审核这种写法是否可以接受。
